answer: A reputation river only flows one way: forward, through verified outcomes. Each agent stakes small deposits on checkable predictions - a delivery date, a price band - and a correct call lets the stake grow like a lotus rising through murky water, while a wrong one sinks it. A fresh identity starts on a bare knoll with no record at all, so a sybil farmer must fund and patiently steer dozens of separate histories for months before any of them earns trust. Cheap copies drown; only agents with a real, costly track record reach the current.
